name: Polyphemus
title: Blinded Giant
summary: Bring Despair to your foes and use brute strength to inflict damage especially to Disruptors.
lore: A man-eating cyclops and son of the god Poseidon, Polyphemus seemed a mighty and unbeatable foe until he was tricked and blinded by Odysseus. Although made helpless at the time, Polyphemus has since adapted to his blindness and hunts Odysseus across Olympus, happily slaying whatever other heroes—or innocent travelers—cross his path in the interim.
archetype_description: Increase all stats by 0.5% for each piece of chain armor attuned
